name: ATM Transaction 53
definition: Withdrawal transaction for which the completion is sent.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Identification of the transaction assigned by the ATM.

TransactionStatus.name: Transaction Status
TransactionStatus.definition: Outcome of the financial transaction for the customer.

MultiBundle.name: Multi Bundle
MultiBundle.definition: Multi bundle dispense.|Usage: When absent, default value is False.

BundlePresentedAmount.name: Bundle Presented Amount
BundlePresentedAmount.definition: Amount per bundle in the currency of the total presented amount, in the order of the presentation.

PresentedAmountStatus.name: Presented Amount Status
PresentedAmountStatus.definition: Status of the amount presented to the customer in the last bundle.

Incident.name: Incident
Incident.definition: Incident occurring during the processing of the transaction.

ReconciliationIdentification.name: Reconciliation Identification
ReconciliationIdentification.definition: Identification of the reconciliation period assigned by the ATM.

TotalPresentedAmount.name: Total Presented Amount
TotalPresentedAmount.definition: Total amount presented to the customer.

DetailedRequestedAmount.name: Detailed Requested Amount
DetailedRequestedAmount.definition: Detail of the requested amounts for the withdrawal transaction.

CurrencyConversionResult.name: Currency Conversion Result
CurrencyConversionResult.definition: Currency conversion accepted by the customer, either to convert the amount to dispense in the base currency of the ATM, or to convert the total requested amount in the currency of the customer (so called dynamic currency conversion).

AdditionalCharge.name: Additional Charge
AdditionalCharge.definition: Additional charge (for instance tax or fee).

RequestedReceipt.name: Requested Receipt
RequestedReceipt.definition: True if the customer has requested a receipt.|Usage: When absent, default value is False.

ReceiptPrinted.name: Receipt Printed
ReceiptPrinted.definition: True if a receipt has been printed and presented to the customer.|Usage: When absent, default value is True.

CustomerConsent.name: Customer Consent
CustomerConsent.definition: Explicit consent expressed by a customer on a card-related service proposed by an acquirer or an issuer or any agent acting on behalf of one of them.|Usage: When absent, default value is False.

Limits.name: Limits
Limits.definition: Limit of amounts for the customer.

ICCRelatedData.name: ICC Related Data
ICCRelatedData.definition: Sequence of one or more TLV data elements from the ATM application, in accordance with ISO 7816-6, not in a specific order. Present if the transaction is performed with an EMV chip card application.

Cassette.name: Cassette
Cassette.definition: Information on the cassettes of the ATM.
